body: ARIES members attended NDTV's Ind.AI Summit, engaging with questions of transformative and responsible AI. The day moved between high-level policy discussions and practical insights from founders and industry leaders on implementing AI at scale in India — including conversations with voices shaping India's AI and quantum missions.
title: NDTV Ind.AI Summit
description: ARIES members at NDTV's Ind.AI Summit — policy, founders, and India's AI roadmap.
